title: The Inspections tab and its actions are hidden without permission or setup
custom_preconds:
1. Test users (Settings - Staff / Roles): one without "Work orders - View"; one with "Work orders - View" but not "Customers - View"; a user who cannot build; and an organisation without ShopCoach.
  2. An asset with no inspections, and an asset with inspections.
custom_steps:
1. As a user without 'Work orders - View', confirm the Inspections tab does not appear at all (absent, not empty).
2. As a user with 'Work orders - View' but not 'Customers - View', confirm the asset record and tab are unreachable with no alternative route.
3. On an asset with no inspections, confirm an empty state explains so.
4. As a user who cannot build, and in an organisation without ShopCoach, confirm the action column shows no build button on any row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Without 'Work orders - View', the Inspections tab does not appear at all; it is absent, not empty.
  • With 'Work orders - View' but not 'Customers - View', the asset record and the tab are unreachable, with no alternative route added.
  • If the asset has no inspections, an empty state explains so.
  • If the user cannot build, the action column shows no button on any row.
  • Without ShopCoach, the action column shows no build button on any row and the Needs action state does not arise.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9103 (S5 — Inspection history on the asset record); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S5; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-N1: “If the user does not have 'Work orders - View' enabled, the Inspections tab will not appear at all. It will be absent, not empty”
  • S5-N2: “If the user has 'Work orders - View' but not 'Customers - View', the asset record is unreachable and so is the tab. No alternative route is added”
  • S5-N3: “If the asset has no inspections, an empty state will explain so”
  • S5-N4: “If the user cannot build, the action column will show no button on any row”
  • S5-N5: “If the organisation does not have ShopCoach, the action column shows no build button on any row. The Needs action state described in S5-R9 does not arise (S2-R0)”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
